runs.input: So basically I started my fitness journey back in March 2021 when my doctor, Dr. Patel, told me my blood pressure was 150 over 95 which honestly scared me a lot. I was working as an accountant in Manchester and sitting at my desk for like ten hours a day. At first I just walked 5,000 steps every day and then I moved up to 10,000 steps and started going to the gym three times a week. My friend Jordan showed me how to deadlift properly. After about eight months I lost 14 kilos and my blood pressure went down to 120 over 80. Now I make videos for people with desk jobs because most fitness content is made for people who already love the gym. You don't need two hours a day, you need twenty minutes and consistency.
